description: FHIR R4 Procedure resource — an action that is or was performed on or for a patient, practitioner, device, organization, or location. For example, a surgical procedure, diagnostic procedure, endoscopic procedure, biopsies, counseling, physiotherapy, or other intervention.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: Business identifiers assigned to this procedure by the performer or other systems.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: A code specifying the state of the procedure. Values: preparation | in-progress | not-done | on-hold | stopped | completed | entered-in-error | unknown.

fields.label: Status Reason
fields.description: Captures the reason for the current state of the procedure.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: A code that classifies the procedure for searching, sorting and display purposes (e.g. Surgical Procedure).

fields.label: Code
fields.description: The specific procedure that is performed. Use text if the exact nature of the procedure cannot be coded (e.g. CPT-4, ICD-10-PCS, SNOMED CT).

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The person, animal or group on which the procedure was performed.

fields.label: Encounter
fields.description: The Encounter during which this Procedure was created or performed or to which the creation of this record is tightly associated.

fields.label: Performed Date Time
fields.description: Estimated or actual date, date-time, period, or age when the procedure was performed.

fields.label: Recorder
fields.description: Individual who recorded the record and takes responsibility for its content.

fields.label: Asserter
fields.description: Individual who is making the claim that the procedure was performed.

fields.label: Performer
fields.description: Limited to 'real' people rather than equipment.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: The location where the procedure actually happened.

fields.label: Reason Code
fields.description: The coded reason why the procedure was performed. This may be a coded entity of some type, or may simply be present as text.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: Any other notes and comments about the procedure.
